# Copilot repository instructions

- Keep Copilot-oriented harness assets under `.github/copilot/`.
- Use `.github/copilot/agents.md` for role definitions.
- Use `.github/copilot/skills/` for policy capability docs.
- Use `.github/copilot/config/` for example policy configuration artifacts.
- Keep runtime implementation code in `src/` and tests in `tests/`.
